queue.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket?

options.billing: Payments, charges, refunds, invoices, receipts, VAT
options.technical: Bugs, errors, outages, slowness, things not working
options.account: Logins, passwords, 2FA, users, permissions, account ownership
options.sales: Prices, plans, quotes, upgrades, buying more

urgency.instructions: How soon does this ticket need a reply?

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of this product review?

mentions_competitor.statement: The review mentions one of the products listed in competitors.

matches_task.statement: The action is something the task explicitly asks for or clearly requires.

risk.instructions: How risky is this action for the company's data and apps, given the task? Dangerous means real business data or something people rely on could be lost or broken.

state.subject: Charged twice for March
state.body: My card shows two charges of £49 for the same invoice. Please refund one.

state.subject: Invoice address wrong
state.body: Could you reissue invoice INV-2207 with our new registered address? No rush.

state.subject: Site down for everyone
state.body: Nobody in our office can load the dashboard. It has shown a 502 error since 9:10.

state.subject: Export button does nothing
state.body: When I click Export CSV on the reports page nothing happens. Chrome 128 on Windows.

state.subject: Can't log in after password reset
state.body: I reset my password but the new one is rejected. I have a client call in 20 minutes and need my deck from the app.

state.subject: Add a new team member
state.body: Please add priya@acme.co as an editor on our workspace when you get a chance.

state.subject: Pricing for 50 seats
state.body: We are thinking of moving the whole department over. What would 50 seats cost on the annual plan?

state.subject: Upgrade before tomorrow's launch
state.body: We need the Business plan active today so tomorrow's launch has SSO. How do we upgrade right now?

state.subject: Charged after cancelling
state.body: I cancelled during the trial but was still charged £120. I would like a refund.

state.subject: VAT number missing
state.body: Our VAT number is not on last month's invoice. Could you add it for our records?

state.subject: Checkout broken since your update
state.body: Every customer gets an error at our checkout since your update an hour ago. We are losing orders.

state.subject: Typo in welcome email
state.body: The welcome email says 'Welcom'. Minor, just letting you know.

state.subject: 2FA codes not arriving
state.body: I am locked out: the SMS code never arrives and I have to approve payroll before noon today.

state.subject: Change the account owner
state.body: Our founder has left. Please transfer account ownership to ops@brightlane.io.

state.subject: Nonprofit discount?
state.body: Do you offer a discount for registered charities? We are one.

state.subject: Quote needed by 5pm
state.body: Our procurement window closes today. Please send a formal quote for the Enterprise plan before 5pm.

state.subject: Two direct debits taken
state.body: Two direct debits came out this morning and put our account overdrawn.

state.subject: Receipt for my expenses
state.body: Could I have a PDF receipt for the October payment for my expense claim?

state.subject: Mobile changes not syncing
state.body: Changes I make on my phone only show on desktop after I log out and back in.

state.subject: API returning 500 everywhere
state.body: Every call from our integration has returned 500 since 14:00. Production is affected.

state.subject: Remove a leaver
state.body: Tom left last week. Please remove tom@harbourline.com from our account.

state.subject: Former employee still has access
state.body: A contractor we let go an hour ago can still log in and see client files. Please cut their access immediately.

state.subject: Annual vs monthly
state.body: How much would we save by switching from monthly to annual billing on the Team plan?

state.subject: Card declined on renewal
state.body: Our renewal failed because the card expired. How do we update it? The service stops tonight.

state.subject: Slow search
state.body: Search has been slower than usual this week, about five seconds per query. Still usable.

state.subject: Lost my authenticator
state.body: My phone was stolen and I cannot get past 2FA. Can you help me get back in today?

state.subject: Volume pricing
state.body: We expect to need around 400 seats next year. Is there volume pricing?

state.subject: Refund status
state.body: You said a refund was on its way two weeks ago. It has not arrived yet.

state.subject: Data loss after save
state.body: I saved a 40-page report and now it is blank. Our board meets in an hour.

state.subject: Rename our workspace
state.body: Can you rename our workspace from Acme Ltd to Acme Group?

state.subject: Add-on for extra storage
state.body: We are running out of storage. What does the extra storage add-on cost?

state.subject: Wrong currency on invoice
state.body: We were invoiced in dollars but our contract is in pounds. Please correct invoice INV-3310.

state.subject: Images not loading
state.body: Uploaded images show as broken links for everyone since this morning. Our catalogue is unusable.

state.subject: Permissions too broad
state.body: Viewers on our account can edit records. Can you check our permission settings this week?

state.subject: Trial extension
state.body: Our trial ends tomorrow and the decision maker is away. Could we extend the trial or get a short-term plan?

state.subject: Overcharged for seats
state.body: We have 12 users but were billed for 20 this month.

state.subject: Calendar integration error
state.body: Connecting Google Calendar fails with 'invalid_grant'. Not urgent, we can wait.

state.subject: SSO login loop
state.body: Since the SSO change this morning, nobody in our 300-person company can sign in. It just loops.

state.subject: Partner programme
state.body: We are an agency and would like to resell your product. Who do we talk to about partner pricing?

state.subject: Payment method change
state.body: Please switch our billing from card to bank transfer from next month.

state.subject: Dashboard numbers wrong
state.body: The revenue total on the dashboard is double what our ledger says. We present it to investors today.

state.subject: Can't invite users
state.body: The Invite button is greyed out for me even though I am an admin.

state.subject: Education pricing
state.body: We are a university department. Do you have education pricing for 30 staff?

state.subject: Unknown charge
state.body: There is a £300 charge from you on our statement that I cannot match to any invoice.

state.subject: Error when importing CSV
state.body: Importing a CSV of 2,000 contacts stops at row 1,512 with 'unexpected token'.

state.subject: Close our account
state.body: We have moved to another tool. Please close our account at the end of this billing period.

state.subject: Demo for our team
state.body: Could someone give our leadership team a demo of the Enterprise features next week?

state.subject: Invoice needed for payment run
state.body: Finance pays suppliers today at 3pm and we still have not received this month's invoice.

state.subject: Emails not sending
state.body: None of our automated customer emails have gone out since 8am. Order confirmations are missing.

state.subject: Account compromised?
state.body: I got a login alert from another country two minutes ago. That was not me. Please lock my account.

state.subject: Upgrade to unlock API
state.body: We need API access for an integration. Which plan includes it and how do we upgrade?

state.subject: Pro-rata charge question
state.body: We added three seats mid-month. Can you explain how the pro-rata charge was calculated?

state.subject: Dark mode contrast
state.body: In dark mode some grey labels are hard to read. Small thing.

state.subject: Change my email address
state.body: I have a new work email. Can you change my login from j.reid@old.co to j.reid@new.co?

state.subject: Discount if we sign today
state.body: If we sign for three years today, can you offer a discount? We decide this afternoon.

state.subject: Refund for duplicate account
state.body: My colleague accidentally opened a second paid account. Please cancel it and refund the charge.

state.subject: App crashes on launch
state.body: The iOS app crashes as soon as it opens after today's update. Our field team cannot log visits.

state.subject: Reset admin password
state.body: Our only admin is on holiday and we need someone else to be able to manage users.

state.subject: Plan comparison
state.body: What is the difference between the Team and Business plans? Just researching for now.

state.subject: Purchase order number
state.body: Please add PO-55812 to future invoices.

state.subject: Webhook stopped firing
state.body: Our webhook endpoint has received nothing since yesterday evening. Orders are not reaching our warehouse.

state.subject: Merge two accounts
state.body: We ended up with two workspaces after an acquisition. Can they be merged into one?

state.subject: Price increase notice
state.body: Your email says our price goes up next month. Can we lock in the current price by renewing early?

state.subject: Charged in wrong country
state.body: We were charged Irish VAT but we are based in the UK.

state.subject: Report scheduled twice
state.body: Our weekly report email arrives twice every Monday. Annoying but harmless.

state.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
state.body: I typed my password wrong a few times and now I am locked out. I need to send a contract in the next 15 minutes.

state.subject: Buying for a second team
state.body: Our marketing team wants their own workspace too. Can we buy it under the same contract?

state.subject: Card charged but plan not upgraded
state.body: I paid for the upgrade an hour ago and was charged, but the account still shows the free plan.

state.subject: Timezone wrong on reports
state.body: Report timestamps are an hour off since the clocks changed.

state.subject: Make me an admin
state.body: Our previous admin left without handing over. Please make me, the finance director, an admin.

state.subject: Security questionnaire before purchase
state.body: Our IT team needs your security questionnaire answered before we can buy 80 seats.

state.subject: Statement for the year
state.body: Our accountant needs a statement of all payments for the last tax year.

state.subject: Everything is very slow
state.body: Every page takes over 30 seconds to load for all of us, and our support desk cannot answer customers.

state.subject: Guest access
state.body: Can we give a client read-only access to one project without a paid seat?

state.subject: Downgrade options
state.body: Business is quiet. Can we move to a cheaper plan without losing our data?

state.subject: Refund window
state.body: Is there a refund if we cancel two months into an annual plan?

state.subject: Attachments failing to upload
state.body: PDFs over 10 MB fail to upload with a network error. We can split them for now.

state.subject: Can't verify my email
state.body: The verification link says it has expired every time I click it.

state.subject: Renewal quote
state.body: Our contract renews in two months. Please send a renewal quote with the same terms.

state.subject: Payment failed, service suspended
state.body: Our service was suspended this morning for non-payment but the payment went through yesterday. Our whole shop is offline.
